description: This image group contains a single image, and it is not a scientific figure. The supplied pixels show a publisher "Check for updates" (Crossref CrossMark) badge: a rounded-square grey/white icon containing a circular logo built of two heavy arcs — a light blue arc occupying the upper and right portion of the ring and a yellow/gold arc occupying the lower and left portion — with a red banner/ribbon shape centred inside the ring, its lower edge cut into a swallow-tail notch. Below the graphic, two lines of dark grey sans-serif text read "Check for" on the first line and "updates" on the second. There are no axes, no units, no scale bars, no data curves, no spectra, no micrographs, no maps, no tables, no legends and no printed numerical values of any kind. Because there is no caption and no panel lettering, the badge cannot be tied to any panel of the Fe35Mn6Al0.1C low-carbon low-density cryogenic steel study; it carries no microstructural, mechanical or deformation-twinning information and must not be used as scientific evidence. It is classified as a graphic element only because the taxonomy contains no icon/logo category, and panel-level description of the figure's actual scientific content is impossible from this image alone.
